items.rationale: This is a frost fracture of a fitting inside the building under 2.4.4 and 7.1.9, renewed like for like. The rate is taken from the identical reference line (Case 25: 51-54).
This is a connection element that had to be renewed with the fractured fitting (7.1.9). The rate is taken from Case 25 (26-28).
Labour on the covered fitting repair is indemnified under 7.1.7(f). Using the prior rate of about 98/hr x 3 hrs gives about 295.
Consumables actually used are nominally covered under 7.1.7(e). However, the same wording paid nothing for this line in earlier cases (Case 25: below 8, possibly 0), so probability is low.
One attendance per undertaking is indemnified under 7.1.11. The rate follows the same-wording reference (Case 25: 38-44).
Leak location is nominally covered under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2, capped at 2,500. The same wording paid nothing for this line before (Case 25: below 28), so probability is low.
A return visit by the same undertaking is not separately indemnified without the insurer's prior agreement (7.1.11).
The facade frost endorsement is agreed, so taking off failed material is covered under 2.6.2. Estimated at about 75 per piece x 2.
Re-forming the substrate is covered under 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c). The amount is a customary trade rate estimate.
Substrate preparation for the damaged area is covered under 2.6.2. The amount is a customary rate estimate.
Priming is expressly listed in 2.6.2. The amount is a customary rate estimate.
Drying where needed before new work is expressly listed in 2.6.2. The amount is a customary rate estimate.
The finish system in the coats it requires is covered under 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d), on the damaged elevation. The amount is a customary rate estimate.
Labour of tradespeople on covered facade work is covered under 2.6.2; the rear repaint is billed separately on line 16. Estimated at about 65/hr x 5 hrs.

Access provision is covered under 2.6.2 and 7.1.8. It served only the damaged elevation and was struck before the rear work, so no apportionment applies. Estimated for about 8 m width over two storeys.
Work on an undamaged elevation is excluded under 2.6.3(a), 7.1.5 and 3.7.
Disposal of removed material is covered under 2.6.2 and 5.2.1. A few rubble sacks, at a customary rate.
Administration charges that price no work are excluded under 3.6(b) and 7.1.12.
Catering for an undertaking's own personnel is excluded under 3.6(a).
